strings.한참 찾았잖아!! 꼼짝 말고 쉬고 있으라고 했더니 대체 어딜 돌아다닌 거: I've been looking everywhere for you! I told you to stay put and rest. Where on earth have you been wandering?
strings.미안해요. 그런데 무슨 일로 불렀어요?: Sorry. What did you call me for?
strings.네가 해줘야 할 일이 있어서 말이야. 거절은 거절할 거야♡: There's something I need you to do. And I refuse to accept a refusal. ♡
Sigh... I suppose I have no choice. I'll gladly help.
strings.그런데 도시 분위기가 심상치 않군요. 무슨 일이라도 있어요?: But something feels off about the city. Has something happened?
You noticed quickly. They've started moving.
It seems soldiers from the Dark Holy Kingdom of Deimos have entered the area.
That's why I want you to go to Kali and warn them.
strings.그래, 칼리. 이스트랜드의 소수 민족 중의 하나인 칼리 족의 마을 '칼리: Yes, Kali. The village of the Kali people, one of Eastland's minority groups.
strings.하늘과 대지의 축복으로 자연의 힘을 강하게 지닌 일족이야. 오래전, 데이: They are a people strongly attuned to nature, blessed by the sky and the earth. Long ago, the Deimos cult hunted them for a certain reason.
strings.그래서 칼리 족은 고향을 버리고 정착할 곳을 찾다 환영의 대지 아드리카: So they abandoned their homeland and searched for a place to settle, eventually reaching a corner of Adrica, the Land of Illusions.
strings.아드키나 영감의 도움으로 자리 잡고 지금까지 살아오고 있어. 아마도 암흑: Old Atkina helped them settle there, and they've lived there ever since. I have a feeling those soldiers are after the Kali people.
I see. Though that's a little unexpected.
I didn't expect you to be concerned about other people, Lady Shynic...
strings.데이모스 교단을 싫어하는 건 대륙의 모든 사람들이 다 같아. 그러니까 쓸: Everyone on this continent hates the Deimos cult. So if you make any silly jokes, I'll kill you. ♡ Understood?
strings.아, 알았어요. 죽이진 말아요. 하여튼, 가서 알리기만 하면 되는 거죠?: Y-yes. Please don't kill me. Anyway, I just need to go and warn them, right?
strings.그래. 칼리 마을엔 네가 만나고 싶어 하는 초인 메디아도 있으니 내가 보: Yes. Medea, one of the Champions you want to meet, is in Kali too. Tell her I sent you. All right?
strings.아, 맞다. 그 전에 해줘야 할 일이 있어. 혹시 몰라 아드리카에 내 환: Oh, right. There's something you should do first. I sent an illusion of myself to Adrica, just in case.
strings.아, 한 대 쥐어 패주고 싶은 그 환영 말이죠?: Oh, that illusion that makes you want to punch it?
strings.너 방금 진심 말했다?: You just said what you really think, didn't you?
strings.뭐, 됐어. 내 환영이 아드리카를 헤매는 사람이 있다고 이야기하더라. 가: Whatever. My illusion told me someone is wandering around Adrica. Go see them on your way. Tell them they'll be safe in Tartaros.
strings.환수들이 사라진 환영의 대지를 헤매기 시작하면 죽을 때까지 빠져나오지 못: With the mythical beasts gone, people who start wandering the Land of Illusions sometimes never find their way out before they die. Understand? Make sure you tell them.
strings.알았어요. 그런데, 칼리는 어느 쪽으로 가면 되나요?: All right. Which way is Kali?
strings.타르타로스 서쪽으로 나가면 환영의 대지 아드리카가 보일 거야. 그대로 쭉: Leave Tartaros to the west, and you'll see Adrica, the Land of Illusions. Just keep going that way.
strings.일반적으로 칼리는 특별한 사람이 아니면 발견할 수 없지만, 넌 여신의 심: Ordinarily, only certain special people can find Kali. But you're the goddess's errand-runner, so you should find it easily.
Then I'll be on my way.
strings.좋아. 난 나대로 여길 지키고 있을 테니 나중에 보자고. 그리고 그분은: Good. I'll be guarding this place, so see you later. And about that person... Huh, gone already...
No helping it. I'll leave meeting that person up to our little friend...
strings.(어떤 소녀가 멍한 표정으로 서성거리고 있다. 샤이닉이 말한 길잃은 사람: (A girl is wandering around with a vacant expression. She seems to be the lost traveler Shynic mentioned.)
Don't be startled! I'm not anyone suspicious.
strings.이상한 사람 아니라고 하는 사람 중에 이상하지 않은 사람이 없긴 하지만…: I've never met anyone who said they weren't suspicious who wasn't suspicious, but...
I'll trust you! I'll give it a try.
strings.제 이름은 미뉴에트예요. 잘 부탁해요!: My name is Minuet. Nice to meet you!
strings.소개는 이쯤에서 하고…. 미뉴에트. 제가 길을 알려드릴 테니 타르타로스라: Well, that's enough introductions... Minuet, I'll show you the way. You should go to a place called Tartaros.
First, I'll clear the area a little and open a path for you. Just wait a moment.
strings.특별한 힘이요? 저한테 그런 게 느껴지나요?: A special power? You can sense something like that in me?
I'm not really sure. I just felt it.
strings.그러고 보니 제가 왜 그렇게 느낀 걸까요?: Come to think of it, why did I feel that?
strings.저는 바빠서 이만 가볼게요. 타르타로스는 동쪽으로 쭉 가면 되니까 조심해: I'm in a hurry, so I'd better go. Keep heading east to reach Tartaros. Travel safely, all right?
strings.(떠나려는 %s의 시야에 미뉴에트의 팔과 다리에 난 상처가 들어온다.): (As %s turns to leave, they notice the wounds on Minuet's arms and legs.)
strings.팔과 다리에 상처가 심하게 있는데 괜찮아요?: You've got some serious wounds on your arms and legs. Are you all right?
strings.쓰라리긴 하지만, 많이 아픈 건 아니에요. 그래도 이 몸은 매우 튼튼한: They sting, but they don't hurt too badly. This body seems to be very sturdy.
strings.이 몸…? 어라, 제가 왜 그런 말을 한 걸까요?: This body...? Huh. Why did I say that?
strings.혹시 어떻게 이곳에 왔는지 설명해 줄래요?: Could you tell me how you came here?
I thought very hard about how to answer you... but I have no idea.
strings.혹시 길을 잃으신 건가요?: Are you lost, by any chance?
strings.그것조차 잘 모르겠어요. 그래도 이름도 모르는 바보가 아니라서 다행이에요: I don't even know that. At least I'm not so foolish that I've forgotten my own name.
strings.고마워요. 그런 이야기는 처음 들어봐요!: Thank you. No one's ever said that to me before!
strings.(미뉴에트를 보고 있으니까 없던 불안감도 마구마구 생기는 것 같네.): (The more I look at Minuet, the more worried I get...)
strings.미뉴에트, 정말 미안해요. 미뉴에트와 함께 타르타로스로 가고 싶은데, 지: Minuet, I'm really sorry. I'd like to take you to Tartaros myself, but I'm far too busy right now. I don't think I can spare the time.
strings.동쪽으로 쭉 가면 타르타로스 입구가 보일 거예요. 제가 오면서 적당히 정: Keep going east, and you'll see the entrance to Tartaros. I cleared the way fairly well on my way here, so it shouldn't be too dangerous, but...
strings.그래도 위험하다 싶으면 이곳으로 다시 돌아오세요. 아셨죠?: If you feel you're in danger, come back here. All right?
Yes, I will. Thank you. Please don't worry too much.
Stop right there. What brings an outsider here?
strings.데이모스 암흑 성국의 병사들이 인근에 출몰한 것 같다고 전해주러 왔습니다: I came to warn you that soldiers from the Dark Holy Kingdom of Deimos seem to have appeared nearby...
Understood. Consider your message delivered. Now leave.
strings.뭐야? 너 너무 무례하잖아!! 내가 그냥 돌아가지 않겠다면 어떻게 할 건: What? That's incredibly rude! What if I refuse to just leave?
Then you'll pay for trespassing in this village.
strings.여신의 가호가 하나도 아니고 둘, 셋? 너 대체 뭐 하는 놈이지?: A goddess's blessing—not one, but two... three? What on earth are you?
strings.셋? 하나도 아니고 둘, 셋? 이리스는 당연한 거라 생각하는데…. 혹시: Three? Not just one, but two or three? Iris's blessing is obvious... Could one be Lady Seres's? But what's the other?
strings.그런데 넌 그걸 어떻게 알고 있는 거지?: How do you know that, anyway?
I hate to admit it, but I can sense such things...
strings.그건 그렇고 너 혹시 서쪽 대륙에서 온 여신의 심부름꾼 같은 건가…?: More to the point, are you the errand-runner for that goddess from the western continent...?
strings.그래. 여신의 일을 조금 하고 있지. 타르타로스에서 이곳으로 위험 상황을: Yes. I do some work for the goddess. They sent me from Tartaros to warn you about the danger.
strings.타르타로스? 샤이닉이 보내서 왔군. 용의 계곡도 아니고 바로 우리 마을로: Tartaros? Shynic sent you. If you came straight to our village rather than Dragon Valley, the situation must be dangerous indeed...
strings.알았다. 그럼 메디아 님이 어디 계신지는 메리멜이 잘 알고 있으니까 그곳: All right. Merimel knows where Lady Medea is. Go see her.
strings.메리멜은 마을 중심부에 있으니 금방 찾을 수 있을 거야. 그리고 주위에: She's in the center of the village, so you'll find her easily. There'll be all sorts of junk around her, but don't worry about that.
You're kinder than I expected. You could have said that from the beginning...
I'm only like that with outsiders. A-and thank you for the compliment.
strings.(이상한 녀석이네. 그럼 메리멜…이란 사람을 찾으러 가볼까.): (What a strange fellow. Well, let's find this Merimel...)
strings.…이걸 이렇게 만들어도 이 마을엔 써주는 사람이 없다니까. 노엘이 없으니: ...I put all this work into making things, but no one in this village uses them. Without Noel, there's no one to appreciate their true worth. Sigh...
strings.이건 뭔가요? 정말 잘 만든 것 같아요. 마을 입구에 있던 사람이 말한: What's this? It looks really well made. You seem just as skilled with your hands as the person at the village entrance said.
strings.이건 새들에게 자동으로 먹이를 주는 급식 기계에요. 후훗, 제가 보기보다: It's a machine that feeds birds automatically. Hehe, I'm handier than I look. But who are you? An outsider? An outsider? An outsider?!
strings.(이건 무슨 반응이지? 좋아하는 건가? 싫어하는 건가?): (What kind of reaction is that? Is she happy or upset?)
Oh, pull yourself together! Even if I hardly ever see outsiders, this is rude.
strings.타르타로스의 샤이닉 님이 메디아라는 분께 가보라고 해서 왔어요. 메디아: Lady Shynic of Tartaros told me to visit someone named Medea. Where can I find her?
strings.외지인한테 제가 말씀드려야 할 이유가 있나요?: Is there any reason I should tell an outsider that?
Would you like something from outside the village? If you don't, there's nothing I can do...
strings.(주머니를 뒤져서 나온 루맨산 육포 하나를 메리멜에게 건네준다.): (You search your pocket and hand Merimel a piece of jerky from Lumen.)
strings.안 그래도 이야기를 들은 거 같아요. 외지에 정말 맛있는 육포가 있다고!: I think I've heard of it! There's supposed to be some delicious jerky in the outside world!
strings.세상에 이렇게 맛있는 음식이라니….(감탄): How can anything taste this good...? (Amazed.)
W-wait. That isn't meant for you to eat... Too late, I suppose.
Sigh... All right. I'll give you a few more pieces.
Ahem. Ahem. Since you've shown your sincerity, I'll tell you where Lady Medea is.
strings.메디아 님은 제일 안쪽에 있는 커다란 나무 앞에 계실 거예요. 외지인이: She should be in front of the enormous tree at the far end of the village. Though she may be uncomfortable with an outsider appearing.
strings.혹시 데이모스 교단 때문인가요?: Is that because of the Deimos cult?
strings.네, 맞아요. 데이모스 교단은 저희 일족을 사냥해요. 특별한 힘이 있다면: Yes. The cult hunts our people. They say we have a special power... I don't know what they do with it, but many of us have fallen victim to them...
So the Deimos cult is the reason you live cut off from the outside world.
strings.그런데 저 같은 외지인을 싫어하는 이유가 있나요? 너무 적대적인 느낌이라: But is there a reason you dislike outsiders like me? Everyone seems so hostile...
strings.잘 모르시는군요. 저희는 기본적으로 일반 인간들과 모습이 달라요. 그 이: You don't know much about us, do you? We look different from ordinary humans. That alone has made life difficult for us for a long time.
We're human too. But outsiders won't acknowledge it.
Not everyone is like that, I'm sure. But many people simply won't accept what's different.
strings.저희는 조금 다르게 생긴 것뿐인데, 인간으로 생각하지 않는 분들이 있어서: We only look a little different, yet some people refuse to see us as human. We've always struggled with that, even when the Deimos cult wasn't involved...
I can see how that would happen. I'm sorry. I didn't think it through.
It's all right. Thank you for understanding, even now...
strings.그래서 메디아 님께서 일원들이 밖으로 나가는 걸 극구 말리는 걸지도 몰라: That may be why Lady Medea is so determined to keep our people from going outside.
strings.그러고 보니 타르타로스에서 오셨다고 했죠? 노엘…. 아, 아니에요. 그럼: Come to think of it, you said you came from Tartaros, didn't you? Noel... Oh, never mind. Please go see Lady Medea.
Thank you. Next time, I'll remember to bring you something from outside.
strings.그, 그럼 이왕이면 유, 육포로 부탁드릴게요!! 그리고 시간 되시면 나중: I-in that case, I'd prefer j-jerky! And when you have time, could you come see me again?
(A faint but potent power emanates from a woman carrying an unusual staff. Her gaze makes her discomfort plain.)
strings.네, 제가 칼리 일족의 메디아 입니다. 외지인이 여기까지 절 만나러 온: Yes. I am Medea of the Kali people. It has been a long time since an outsider came this far to see me.
Then this should be quick to explain. The reason I'm here is...
strings.환영의 대지의 상태가 나빠진 걸 보니 데이모스 교단의 병사들이 몰려왔군요: The worsening state of the Land of Illusions tells me that soldiers of the Deimos cult have arrived.
strings.저희는 언제나 그랬던 것처럼 조용히 숨을 죽이고 그들이 떠나기만을 기다릴: As we always have, we will remain quiet and hidden, waiting for them to leave.
Go back, outsider. I do not trust you.
strings.아무리 여신의 총애를 받고 있다 해도 해드릴 수 있는 건 없습니다. 제: However much favor the goddess shows you, there is nothing I can do for you. Even if I gave you my power, I don't know whether it would help her.
strings.제가 전부 말씀드리지 않았는데, 어디까지 알고 계신가요?: I haven't explained everything yet. How much do you know?
strings.당신에게서 샤이닉의 기운이 느껴지고 있거든요. 죽지 못해 사는 불길한 저: I can sense Shynic's presence within you. The power of one who lives only because an ominous curse prevents her from dying...
strings.물론 샤이닉이 절 아껴 당신을 보낸 건 알고 있습니다. 하지만 외지인의: Of course, I know Shynic sent you out of concern for me. But I cannot simply accept an outsider's intentions. I hope you understand.
strings.잠깐, 당신…. 지금 절 찾아온 것보다 중요한 일이 있을 텐데요?: Wait. You... Isn't there something more important for you to do than visit me right now?
strings.오늘이 설마…. 아, 혹시 환영의 대지, 아드리카를 헤매는 사람을 본 적: Could today be...? Ah, did you happen to see anyone wandering around Adrica, the Land of Illusions?
strings.네, 안 그래도 길을 헤매는 소녀가 있어서 타르타로스로 가라고 길을 알: Yes. There was a girl who had lost her way. I gave her directions to Tartaros.
That lady... I mean, that person may not be able to leave the Land of Illusions.
strings.그게 무슨 말씀이시죠?: What do you mean by that?
strings.데이모스 교단의 병사들이 환수를 사냥하면서 대지는 자신을 제어할 수 없게: As the Deimos soldiers hunted the mythical beasts, the land lost its ability to regulate itself.
strings.환수들과 환영의 식물들이 외지인들을 땅과 생명을 위협하는 존재로 인식하기: The mythical beasts and illusion plants began to see outsiders as threats to the land and its life, and absorbed the power of anyone they identified that way.
strings.흡수당한 힘에는 그들의 기억 또한 포함됐습니다. 영원히 환영의 대지 속에: That power included their memories. The land stripped away their recollections so they would wander here forever, until they died.
strings.그렇게 죽은 외지인들은 땅으로 돌아가 환수와 환영 식물들의 양분이 됩니다: Those outsiders return to the earth and become nourishment for the mythical beasts and illusion plants.
strings.위, 위험하잖아요!! 그런데 저는 어떻게 지나갈 수 있던 거죠? 분명 저: Th-that's dangerous! But how was I able to pass through? Surely the same thing should have happened to me...
strings.여신의 일을 하는 사람이니 벗어날 수 있었을 테죠…. 이러고 있을 때가: You serve a goddess, so you were able to escape it... This is no time to linger. Go at once and check on that lady.
If her condition hasn't changed, go to Dragon Valley and ask Lord Atkina for help. He must be facing difficulties of his own right now, but...
strings.가면서 환영의 대지를 어지럽히는 존재들을 정리해주세요. 서둘러야 합니다…: On your way, deal with the beings disturbing the Land of Illusions. You must hurry...
Yes, I'm fine. You saved me.
I'm glad nothing happened to you...
strings.말씀하신 대로 다시 이곳으로 돌아왔어요. 아니, 저는 다시 돌아오고 말았: I came back here, just as you said. No... I ended up back here.
strings.…그게 무슨 말이죠? 돌아오고 말았다니??: ...What do you mean? You ended up back here?
strings.이곳에서 벗어나려고 마을이 있는 방향으로 걸었는데, 그때마다 전 정신을: I walked toward the town to try to leave this place, but every time I did, I lost consciousness.
When I came to, I was always here...
As if I'm not allowed to leave this place...
strings.진짜요? 그럼 제가 미뉴에트를 붙잡고 가볼게요!: Really? Then I'll take you with me and hold on to you!
strings.(미뉴에트를 붙잡고 어떤 길로 향해도 미뉴에트가 있던 원래의 자리로 돌아: (No matter which path you take while holding on to Minuet, you return to the place where she was standing.)
See? That's why it's so frustrating.
strings.(무슨 저주라도 있는 건가? 답답하네.): (Is there some kind of curse? This is maddening.)
strings.메디아라는 분이 미뉴에트가 똑같은 상황이라면 용의 계곡에 가보라고 했는데: Someone named Medea told me to go to Dragon Valley if your situation hadn't changed...
strings.네, 괜찮아요. 좀 지친 것 같아요. 잠이 오는 것 같은데…. 어떻게든: Yes, I'm fine. I think I'm a little tired. I feel sleepy... but I'll try to stay awake. How strange.
strings.미뉴에트, 여기서 기다려요. 어떻게든 아드키나를 만나서 방법을 마련할테니: Minuet, wait here. I'll find Atkina and work out a way to help you, somehow. Please wait for me. At least this spot seems safe...
strings.(미뉴에트가 많이 지쳤는지 그대로 바위에 기대 잠이 들어버린다.): (Apparently exhausted, Minuet leans against a boulder and falls asleep.)
strings.서둘러야겠네. 여기는 안전하겠지?: I'd better hurry. She'll be safe here, won't she?
strings.분명 시작은 샤이닉의 부탁으로 칼리 족에게 위험하다고 전해주는 것뿐이었는: This started as nothing more than Shynic asking me to warn the Kali people about danger...
No. I'll save the idle thoughts for later. Time to go.
strings.키리에를 붙잡고 있던 어둠이 물러났군. 용의 계곡이 이렇게 어둠으로 가득: The darkness holding Kyrie has receded. When was the last time Dragon Valley was so filled with darkness...?
It's a pleasure to meet you, Lord Atkina. I am...
I heard a follower of Goddess Iris had come to this continent. So that was you. Thanks to you, the darkness in Dragon Valley has vanished.
strings.언젠가 자네가 이곳에 올 거란 짐작은 했었네. 그래도 이런 식으로 만나고: I expected you would come here someday. Though I had hoped we would meet under different circumstances...
strings.부끄럽군. 어둠에 물든 환수들 때문에 주인인 내가 내 영역에 갇혀 있어야: How shameful. The lord of this domain, trapped in his own lands by mythical beasts tainted with darkness...
strings.데이모스 교단 병사들이 조용하다 싶더니 또 환수들과 칼리 족을 사냥하러: The Deimos soldiers had been quiet, but now they've come here again to hunt the mythical beasts and the Kali people.
strings.환수와 칼리족의 힘을 어딘가에 쓰고 있긴 한데, 정확히 어디에 쓰고 있는: They're using the power of the beasts and the Kali for something. It's frustrating that we still haven't discovered exactly what.
strings.그러고보니 그대가 이곳을 찾은 이유를 듣지 못했군. 무슨 일인가?: Come to think of it, I haven't heard why you sought me out. What is it?
strings.(아드키나에게 초인의 힘을 모으고 있는 것부터 아드리카에서 길을 헤맨 소: (You tell Atkina about gathering the Champions' power, and about Minuet, the girl wandering lost in Adrica.)
strings.잠깐, 그분이 환영의 대지에 계신가? 기억을 잃으시다니…, 지금 아드리카: Wait. That lady is in the Land of Illusions? And she has lost her memory...? Adrica is in danger.
I do. Please go to her in my place and awaken her memories. If you don't, there's no telling what might happen...
Adrica is in danger. You must restore her memories at once.
strings.대체 미뉴에트가 어떤 사람이기에 그러는 거죠? 그리고 제가 어떻게 해야: Who exactly is Minuet, for you to react like this? And what am I supposed to do?
strings.직접 만나는 게 빠를 걸세. 그리고 그대가 따르는 그분을 나에게 인사시켜: It will be quicker to meet her yourself. And introduce the one you follow to me. That will be the quickest way.
strings.아직 이리스가 가진 힘이 부족해서 이야기하는 게 힘들 수도 있을 것 같아: Iris's power is still lacking. It may be difficult for her to speak with you.
strings.(아드키나가 하늘을 향해 한 손을 뻗는다. 잠시 후, 어디선가 맑고 깨끗: (Atkina raises a hand toward the sky. A moment later, a clear, pure breeze arrives from somewhere, passes through his hand, and brushes %s's face.)
strings.이리스 님과 그분에게 필요한 힘일세. 알아듣기 쉽게 '기억의 파편'이라고: This is power that both Iris and that lady need. To put it simply, call it a 'Memory Fragment.' I've also passed a portion of my own power to you.
I will greet Iris separately. You should hurry to that lady.
strings.네, 네…. 그런데 그냥 가기만 하면 되는 건가요?: Y-yes... Do I just go to her?
strings.환수들이 가지고 있던 기억의 파편은 이미 그대의 손 끝에 녹아있네. 그러: The Memory Fragments held by the mythical beasts have already merged into your fingertips. Take her hand.
You have my word, as one who followed the mistress of the moon, flowers, and growing things.
strings.(분명 언젠가 만났던 것 같은데, 왜 제대로 기억이 나지 않지…?): (I'm sure I've met her sometime before. Why can't I remember clearly...?)
strings.난 환영의 대지의 정화를 시작할 테니 일단 그분부터 도와주게. 아, 그리: I will begin purifying the Land of Illusions, so help her first. Oh, and...
strings.이곳의 일이 모두 끝난 후 날 찾아오지 않겠나? 급한 일은 아닐세. 자네: Once everything here is resolved, would you come see me? It's nothing urgent. I'd like to speak to you about your memories.
Yes, understood. I'll go right away.
strings.(용의 계곡을 떠나는 %s의 뒷모습이 사라지자 아드키나 앞으로 이리스의: (When %s disappears from view on the way out of Dragon Valley, Iris's faint image appears before Atkina.)
strings.처음 뵙겠습니다. 이리스 여신이시여. 세레스 님과 그 아이를 꼭 닮으셨군: It is a pleasure to meet you, Goddess Iris. You look just like Lady Seres and that child.
strings.세레스 님께서 '데르'라 부르며 소중히 여겼던 존재…. 여신님의 먼 조상: The one Lady Seres cherished and called 'Tyr'... Your distant ancestor...
strings.감사해요, 아드키나. 그녀를 기억해 주셔서…. 아드키나와 할 이야기가 많: Thank you, Atkina. For remembering her... I have much to discuss with you, but could you wait a little longer?
The darkness has not yet left the Land of Illusions. And the sinner, too...
strings.죄인이라면…, 혹시 제가 짐작하는 자가 맞습니까?: The sinner... Is it the person I suspect?
Yes, I'm fine. This place is gradually becoming clearer. I think it's making me feel better.
strings.다행이에요. 일단 제 손을 한 번 잡아볼래요?: That's a relief. Would you take my hand for a moment?
strings.아드키나란 분이 미뉴에트의 기억을 돌릴 방법을 알려주셨는데, 손을 잡으면: Atkina told me how to restore your memories. He said I should hold your hand...
Believe it or not, let's give it a try.
strings.(미뉴에트가 고개를 끄덕이며 %s의 손을 붙잡는다. 잠시 후, 맑고 깨끗: (Minuet nods and takes %s's hand. A moment later, a clear, pure breeze blows in from somewhere and brushes their joined hands.)
(A sharp gust follows, forcing you to let go of Minuet's hand.)
I'm all right, %s... Thanks to you, my memories have returned.
That's a relief. Then let me guide you to the nearest town.
strings.그렇게 하지 않으셔도 될 것 같아요. 그리고 제 소개를 다시 할게요. 저: I don't think that will be necessary. And allow me to introduce myself again. I am...
strings.(미뉴에트의 앞으로 환영의 대지 아드리카에서 볼 수 없었던 신비한 빛이: (A mysterious light, unlike anything seen in Adrica, the Land of Illusions, begins to spread before Minuet.)
strings.(눈이 멀 것 같은 기분이 든다. 서둘러 한쪽 팔을 들어 눈을 가린다.): (It feels as though the light could blind you. You quickly raise an arm to shield your eyes.)
strings.(미뉴에트의 목소리가 살짝 달라진 것 같다. 고개를 들어 앞을 바라보니: (Minuet's voice seems subtly different. You lift your head and see a being who resembles her, yet is altogether different.)
strings.고마워요. 덕분에 기억을 되찾을 수 있었어요. 제 이름은 가이아…. 이: Thank you. You helped me recover my memories. My name is Gaia... I helped shape this land for my younger sister Seres, who loved this world...
strings.(갑자기 머릿속에 가이아의 존재가 확실하게 느껴진다. 빛과 함께 그녀의: (Suddenly, you become acutely aware of Gaia's presence. Her name seems to have been etched into your mind along with the light.)
strings.대지의 여신 가이아…. 가이아 님?: Gaia, Goddess of the Earth... Lady Gaia?
strings.미안해요. 당신을 이렇게 만나고 싶지 않았는데…. 오래전 대륙을 지키고자: I'm sorry. I didn't want us to meet this way... Long ago, I exhausted all my power protecting the continent. Since then, I have alternated between sleep and wakefulness.
Unable to spend much power, I would roam briefly in human form. Minuet is my present human incarnation.
strings.이번에 깨어나 환영의 대지를 둘러보던 중에 깊고 사악한 어둠을 만나게 됐: When I woke this time and was looking around the Land of Illusions, I encountered a profound, wicked darkness. I was on my way to consult Atkina when...
You may call me a weak god. This was all my own failure...
strings.인간의 모습을 한 신께서 기억을 잃어버릴 정도시면 엄청나게 위험하다는 거: If even a god in human form could lose her memory, the danger must be immense.
strings.미안해요. 제 기억이 일부 돌아오긴 했지만, 제 힘은 제대로 돌아오지 못: I'm sorry. Some of my memories have returned, but my power has not fully recovered...
strings.제가 기억을 잃고 헤매는 동안 환영의 대지에 있는 제 공간이 어둠을 부리: While I wandered without my memories, a wielder of darkness overran my sanctuary in the Land of Illusions, and Atkina became trapped as well.
strings.전 괜찮아요, 가이아 님. 그러면 제가 무슨 일을 하면 되는 건가요?: I'm all right, Lady Gaia. What should I do, then?
strings.저의 처소, '라피어' 안을 확인해 주시겠어요? 상황이 어떤지 지금 제: Would you check inside my sanctuary, Lapier? In my present condition, I can't tell what is happening there...
strings.(신의 나무 라피어의 깊은 곳. 한 남자가 어떤 불길한 존재와 같이 있다: (Deep inside the divine tree Lapier, a man stands beside an ominous being. For a moment, your eyes meet.)
strings.(이 신성한 곳, 여신의 처소에 불길한 힘을 지닌 존재가 들어왔다면….): (A being with sinister power has entered this sacred place, the goddess's sanctuary...)
strings.(분명 적이겠지. 이곳까지 침범한 걸 보면 보통 인간은 아닌 것 같은데…: (He must be an enemy. Anyone who could intrude this far can't be an ordinary human...)
(As soon as the suspicious man finishes speaking, the ominous being beside him steps forward.)
strings.신을 돕는 자여, 죽음에 걸맞는 진혼곡 '레퀴엠'이 너를 인도할테니 기꺼: You who aid a god—embrace your fate. Requiem, a funeral song worthy of death, shall guide you...
Interesting. To think Requiem would meet such an end...
strings.(후우, 후우…. 후우우. 힘들어. 죽을 것 같았어….): (Huff... huff... whew. That was rough. I thought I was going to die...)
A pity, but I'll postpone your death until next time.
strings.어딜 가려고!! 여기서 대체 무슨 일을 꾸미고 있는 거야?!: Where do you think you're going?! What are you plotting here?!
strings.(수상한 남자를 향해 달려들지만, 이상한 장벽에 가로막혀 다가갈 수 없다: (You rush toward the suspicious man, but a strange barrier prevents you from reaching him. Instead, an unfamiliar force closes in and begins constricting your entire body.)
strings.재미있군. 아무 대가 없이 신을 돕다니…. 너는 이 세계가 제대로 유지될: Interesting. You help a god without asking anything in return... You must believe this world can continue as it is.
Wh-what are you talking about? Aaaah! Gaaaah...
strings.(수상한 남자가 손가락을 흔들 때마다 온몸에 엄청난 고통이 새겨진다.): (Every flick of the suspicious man's finger sends excruciating pain through your body.)
strings.가서 네가 믿는 신에게 전해라. 나약한 신이 사랑한 세계는 곧 사라질 거: Go and tell the god you believe in: the world that weak god loved will soon disappear. Through the power of this 'binding'...
That should be enough of a scare...
strings.(수상한 남자가 손의 움직임을 멈추자 온 몸을 괴롭히던 고통들이 사라진다: (When the suspicious man stops moving his hand, the pain tormenting your body vanishes.)
strings.고통을 견딘 대가로 내 이름을 알려주지. 내 이름은 바이스. 이 땅의 생: For enduring that pain, I'll give you my name. I am Weiss. The being so cursed by the creatures of this land...
And one who has no choice but to sin...
strings.(바이스가 쓰러져 괴로워하는 %s의 모습을 빤히 바라본다. 그러다 살며시: (Weiss stares at %s, collapsed and writhing in pain. Then he smiles faintly.)
strings.그러면 재회할 날을 기다리지. 네가 그때까지 이 땅에서 살아있다면 가능하: Then I shall await our next meeting. Assuming you're still alive in this world by then...
strings.대체 무슨 소리지? 세계가 사라진다니…. 아, 알려야 해…. 으, 으윽: What does he mean? The world will disappear...? I have to warn them... U-urgh... First, Lady Gaia.
strings.(미뉴에트가 천천히 가이아의 모습으로 변한다. 기억을 잃은 채 아드리카를: (Minuet slowly takes Gaia's form. The girl who wandered Adrica without her memories is nowhere to be seen.)
strings.덕분에 라피어에 있던 어둠이 물러났어요. 아드리카에도 어둠이 느껴지지 않: Thanks to you, the darkness in Lapier has receded. I no longer sense darkness in Adrica, either.
strings.감사해요. 이제 다시 라피어에 들어갈 수 있을 것 같아요. 그런데 %s,: Thank you. I believe I can enter Lapier again now. But %s, you don't look well. Would you tell me what's wrong?
strings.(신의 나무 라피어에서 있었던 일을 가이아에게 이야기한다.): (You tell Gaia what happened inside the divine tree Lapier.)
So he was the one who brought all that wicked darkness here.
And this object comes from another world...
strings.(갑자기 이상한 기분이 온 몸을 감싼다.): (A strange feeling suddenly envelops your entire body.)
strings.이 느낌은 바이스를 만났을 때…. 그래, 두려움…. 두려움이야. 그동안: This feeling... from when I met Weiss... Yes, fear. It's fear. I've hardly ever felt afraid before... Why now...?
strings.가, 가이아 님…. 바이스는 누구죠? 어째서 이런 일을 하는 거죠?: L-Lady Gaia... Who is Weiss? Why is he doing this?
strings.(갑자기 가이아의 목소리가 들려오지 않는다. 이내 시야가 흐려져 더 이상: (Suddenly, you can no longer hear Gaia's voice. Your vision soon blurs, until you cannot even see her.)
It's dark... Where am I? I can't see anything...
You summoned us here... So it was you after all...
It's been a long time. Your name was Gaia, I believe...
strings.(어디선가 들려오는 노인의 나지막한 목소리. 단어 하나하나에 엄청난 압력: (An old man's low voice sounds from somewhere. Every word carries tremendous pressure.)
strings.(다리에 힘이 풀려 도저히 일어날 수 없다. 고개를 들어 바라본 가이아의: (Your legs give way, leaving you unable to stand. You look up and see Gaia's face drawn tight.)
As I thought, Gaia does not welcome me. But that is quite all right.
This world, abandoned even by the gods when that absurd power of chaos and darkness swept over it...
strings.분명 멸망이 머지 않았던 것 같은데, 아직도 버티고 있다니 대단하군. 그: I was certain its destruction was near. Impressive that it still holds on. I once sent this world a gift, you know.
strings.자멸해버린 새를 기억하나? 어둠에게 지배를 받을 수 밖에 없게 만들어진: Do you remember the bird that destroyed itself? The slave created to be subject to darkness, without any choice in the matter.
strings.한 인간을 위해 불꽃을 꺼트린…. 그 이야긴 새로운 신을 따르는 저 인간: It extinguished its flames for a single human... That human who follows the new god should know the story, too.
strings.아, 자네가 잠이 들어서 모르나 본데…, 그런 일이 있었다네. 그럼 이: Ah, perhaps you were asleep and didn't know... But it did happen. Well, enough of that story.
strings.묻고 싶은게 있네. 그래서 자넨 어떤가?: There's something I want to ask. What about you?
strings.자네의 힘을 모두 소진할 만큼 인간들과 이 세계는 가치가 있는 겐가?: Are humans and this world worth exhausting every last bit of your power?
strings.자, 보게나. 자네가 잠든 이후, 세계가 자네가 원하는 대로 흘러갔는지를: Look for yourself. Since you fell asleep, has the world unfolded as you wished...?
strings.마왕이란 존재도 어쩌지 못하는 나약한 신이 아무것도 하지 않은 채, 구원: How laughable: a weak god unable to deal with even the Demon King, doing nothing while waiting for a savior.
strings.어차피 자네는 대답하지 않을 걸 나는 알고 있네. 애초에 바라지도 않았으: I know you won't answer me. I never expected you to.
strings.마왕이 아니라 하더라도 언젠가 자네의 세계는 소멸될 걸세. 그걸 원하는: Even without the Demon King, your world will perish someday. There are those who wish it so. Don't forget that I am one of them.
strings.이미 자네와 자네가 아끼는 생명, 그리고 자네가 아끼는 이 세계를 소멸시: I have already sent something to destroy you, the lives you cherish, and this world you love.
A gift I selected with considerable care.
strings.나에게 그렇게 말해도 난 그만할 수가 없네. 처음부터 자네와 내 역할은: However much you tell me to stop, I cannot. You know our roles have made this inevitable from the very beginning, don't you?
I meant to summon only you, but somehow that human came along as well.
strings.세레스의 뒤를 이어 인간에서 신이 된 소녀는 한 인간을 동화시켰지. 그리: The girl who succeeded Seres, rising from human to god, brought a human into attunement with herself. And...
strings.그를 건드리지 마세요!! 머리카락 하나라도 건드린다면 가만두지 않겠어요!: Don't touch them! Harm so much as a hair, and I won't let you get away with it! Besides, frightening people is all you can do!
strings.가소롭군, 가이아. 아무런 힘도 없어 잠이나 자는 자네가 뭘 할 수 있단: How ridiculous, Gaia. What could you do, powerless and forever sleeping?!
Then I shall leave things here for today.
strings.언젠가 세레스를 만난다면 안부 전해주게. 그렇게 아꼈던 세계는 흔적도 없: If you meet Seres someday, give her my regards. Tell her the world she loved so much vanished without a trace. Hahahahaha...
This world will disappear...? That's absurd...
strings.(계속해서 머리와 어깨를 짓누르던 원초적인 힘 때문에 겨우 붙잡고 있던: (The primal power relentlessly pressing down on your head and shoulders dims the consciousness you've barely managed to hold on to.)
strings.(가이아의 목소리가 점점 작아지더니 더는 들려오지 않는다.): (Gaia's voice grows fainter until you can no longer hear it.)
strings.(미뉴에트였던 소녀의 모습이 가이아의 모습으로 변한다.): (The girl who was Minuet takes Gaia's form.)
I'm sorry... Those are the only words a weak god can offer...
That old man... I once saw the Memorial of someone he'd sent. I heard that voice there. I never thought I'd hear it like this...
strings.미안해요. 당장은 드릴 수 있는 말씀이 없어요. 때가 된다면 알게 되시겠: I'm sorry. I can't tell you anything right now. You'll learn when the time comes, but...
strings.저는 괜찮아요. 누구나 말 못할 사정 같은 건 있으니까 이해해요. 그게: It's all right. Everyone has things they can't speak about. I understand. Even if that someone is a god...
strings.고마워요, %s…. 어둠도 물러나고 아드키나가 시작한 정화의 의식도 끝나: Thank you, %s... The darkness has receded, and Atkina has finished the purification ritual. You may return now.
strings.이제 이곳을 떠나시면 당분간 제 모습을 보실 수 없을 거예요. 힘을 사용: Once you leave here, you won't be able to see me for a while. Using my power could send me back to sleep again.
strings.혹시 다시 만날 수 있을까요?: Will we be able to meet again?
I can't give you a definite answer. But I can promise one thing.
strings.이곳에 당신이 오는 순간 만큼은 대화를 할 수 있도록 미뉴에트를 세워둘게: Whenever you come here, I will leave Minuet waiting so you can speak with her.
strings.미뉴에트는 제 현신, 일부지만 저와 이어져 있어요. 이제 미뉴에트는 당신: Minuet is my incarnation. Though only a part of me, she remains connected to me. From now on, only you will be able to see her. Come and speak to her whenever you need to.
strings.%s, 메디아와 샤이닉에게 가서 제 이야길 하세요. 그러면 그들은 무슨: %s, go to Medea and Shynic and tell them about me. They will naturally understand what happened.
Thank you for everything. We will meet again.
strings.나중에 가이아 님에게 부탁할 일이 있으시다거나 대화하시고 싶으면 이곳에: If you ever need to ask Lady Gaia for something, or want to speak with her, come see me here.
strings.네, 알았어요. 그런데, 미뉴에트를 여신님과 별개의 인격으로 봐도 될까요: All right. But should I think of you as a separate person from the goddess, Minuet?
Hmm... You could say we're the same, or that we're different.
strings.왠지 알 것도 같아요. 가이아…님?: I think I understand. Lady... Gaia?
You may call me Minuet while I'm in this form.
strings.알았어요, 미뉴에트. 그나저나 가이아 님께서 이리스를 만나게 해드리지 않: All right, Minuet. But is it okay for me to leave without introducing Iris to Lady Gaia?
They may already be meeting privately in some way we don't know about.
I suppose you're right. Then I'll see you next time, Minuet...
You're still looking at me as though I make you uncomfortable.
strings.그렇게 느끼셨다면 죄송합니다. 그리고 환영의 대지의 기운과 더불어 여신께: I'm sorry if I gave that impression. The Land of Illusions has regained its vitality, and the goddess has returned. The remaining Deimos cultists have vanished, too...
strings.가이아 님께서 직접 오시지 않았지만, 무슨 일이 어떻게 일어났는지는 알려: Lady Gaia did not come in person, but she told me what happened.
Hm? Oh, I suppose I'll keep doing what I've done so far.
strings.묻고 싶은 게 있는데, 실례가 되지 않는다면 괜찮을까요?: There's something I'd like to ask, if it wouldn't be too rude.
strings.당신은 당신의 신을 위해서 하는 일이, 그 길이 옳다고 생각하나요?: Do you believe the work you do for your god—the path you follow—is right?
strings.저는 지금까지 오면서 다른 생각을 해본 적이 없어요. 그저 이리스를 만나: I've never really considered anything else along the way. I came this far thinking only of finding Iris. Of course, there were difficult times.
So you came all this way for Iris alone.
I see. That was a good answer.
strings.왠지 질문이 더 있을 것 같은데…, 그게 전부인가요?: I feel as though you have more questions... Was that everything?
Yes. Your answer was enough. I understand what kind of person you are now.
strings.확실하다고 할 수는 없지만, 제가 당신을 조금은 신뢰할 수 있을 것 같아: I can't say for certain, but I think I can trust you a little. Until that trust is complete... please visit us often.
Perhaps... when that time comes, we may have a different conversation.
That's a good sign, then. I'll try to earn your trust...
strings.모든 일에는 빛과 그림자가 있어요. 꼭 빛이 선이 아니고, 어둠이 악이: Everything has light and shadow. Light is not always good, just as darkness is not always evil. The same applies to your power and to what you do. Please remember that.
Yes. I'll keep that in mind.
If you're heading back, please give Shynic my regards.
Well done, %s! You kept me thoroughly entertained! Ahahahaha!
I see you've found out what happened without my telling you again.
That's right. Thanks to her influence, I know a fair amount.
strings.그건 그렇고 제가 가기 전에 무슨 일이 일어날지 예상했던 거 아닌가요?: But didn't you already expect what would happen before I left?
I knew half of it. The other half, I didn't.
strings.반은 뭐고, 다른 반은 뭐예요?: Which half did you know, and which didn't you?
strings.비밀이야. 그나저나 그분을 만난 소감이 어때? 원래는 내가 소개해주려고: That's a secret. Anyway, how did it feel to meet her? I meant to introduce you myself, originally...
strings.그냥 알고 지내는 신 한 분이 더 늘었다는 거 정도?: I suppose it means there's one more god among my acquaintances?
What a boring answer. And there was someone else you met.
strings.(순간 그자의 얼굴이 떠올라 몸이 떨린다. 이스트랜드에 와서 처음 겪는: (His face flashes through your mind, making you tremble. Your first true moment of terror since coming to Eastland...)
strings.겁먹었군. 그의 힘을 경험한 사람이라면 당연히 그럴 수 있어. 공포과 전: You're frightened. Anyone who's experienced his power would be. He's almost as close to absolute evil as Deimos, the Twisted One, god of fear and war...
strings.이제 바이스를 자주 보게 될 거야. 그가 움직였다면 조만간 큰일이 일어날: You'll be seeing Weiss more often now. If he's made his move, something big may happen soon.
strings.본의 아니게 내가 겁을 많이 줬나? 아하하하. 이제 쉽지 않을 거야. 너: Did I scare you more than I meant to? Ahahaha. Things won't be easy from now on. Neither you nor the god you serve can afford to back down. Understood?
Yes, I'm fine. If I rest... a little rest should help. Just a little rest...
All right. Don't overdo it... But you won't be able to rest for long.
strings.(샤이닉이 힘없이 숙소로 돌아가는 %s의 뒷모습을 빤히 바라본다.): (Shynic watches %s intently as they trudge back to their lodgings.)
strings.뭐, 일단 이걸로 당분간 별 일 없으려나. 하지만, 신들이 제 몫을 하지: Well, perhaps things will stay quiet for a little while now. But the gods still aren't doing their part... Ugh. How dull.
Tell that beast in the hat. That man is a 'real one,' just like you lot...
